title: Generative AI-Driven Full-Process Computer-Aided Design
summary: AInnovation completed a ChatCAD MVP integrated with Bentley software. Faster design and shorter product-development cycles remain intended benefits.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AInnovation completed a ChatCAD MVP integrated with Bentley software and plans a commercial rollout. Faster design and shorter product-development cycles remain intended benefits.
purpose: Help designers create and revise industrial designs through generative AI.

ratings.reason: Design businesses are intended to improve design efficiency and product development.
Designers are intended to use natural-language tools more easily; no individual capability outcome is recorded.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 6: Generative AI-Driven Full-Process Computer-Aided Design

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: Integration with CAD software and relevant design data

headline: ChatCAD brings natural-language assistance to design
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
